## Architecture overview

Finish three original, bounded observations without changing product governance,
review policy, host permissions or working capabilities. The operator renewed the
original completion request on 2026-09-30. The accepted baseline is `dcccf5f2`.
This is the light planning path for known corrections, not a new repository audit.

## Interfaces and contracts

The shell-step runner retains its arguments, source/target separation, environment
preparation and the sourced step's normal status and trap semantics. Only its
owned stdin temporary file gains catchable-signal cleanup. The header-loader
product bytes are unchanged. CODEOWNERS remains review-routing metadata; it does
not enforce reviews or change branch rules.

## Constraints

Preserve source signatures, schemas, guard logic, converters and rendered formats.
No change to held hooks 1b or the separately held ADR-drafting candidate. No model,
provider, policy, credential, external deployment, licence or history change.
Keep original evidence historical, and obtain independent review of changed bytes.
The new coordinator's neutral profile adds no mandatory company controls.
